steps.what: Retrieve the actual treatment goals and dated client progress observations
Review the client's progress and experience with the client in relation to the treatment goals
Evaluate progress against the measurable goals and decide what the evidence means for ongoing care
Write and check the actual clinical progress evaluation note against the goals and supporting evidence

loop.purpose: Organize the counselor's existing working notes into the current progress-note headings without making a care decision.
loop.input: Existing working notes, the counselor's evaluation and dated goal references.
loop.output: A source-linked draft clinical progress note.
loop.check: Counselor checks every statement, attribution, date, goal comparison and any risk wording against the source; unsupported conclusions are removed.
loop.stop: Missing source, ambiguous attribution or unsupported risk wording stops the draft for manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot organize varied free-text observations; use it alone if structured notes already suffice.

steps.what: Save the checked progress note in the existing client clinical record

tasks.design: Use the clinical record {OTHER} to show dated goals beside existing progress observations. A bounded drafting step can organize the counselor's existing working notes, while the client discussion, evaluation and complete clinical note check remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Goals and dated observations can be scattered, and free-text evaluations need repeated organization into the clinical note.
tasks.enabler_now: Native goal views and bounded text drafting can shorten navigation and note composition without evaluating the client.
tasks.still_hard: Reported change, missing observations, therapeutic context and risk cannot be reduced to a goal score.
tasks.human_edge: The counselor understands the client's account and decides what apparent progress means for care.

ambition.what: The same goal review and clinical evaluation retain the counselor's judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a dated goal view and a source-bound draft can reduce clinical note navigation and composition; a counselor must check the meaning and retains all care evaluation.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the actual clinical/case-record system. Boundary includes the goal review, clinical evaluation and the clinical note actually read by the care team; no additional summary or recording is invented.

The existing treating team produces goal ID, goal text, measure, target and review date plus dated observations with author and source. s1 retains source reading, missing information and checking; s2-s3 produce the client's context and counselor's evaluation. s4 retains current working-note capture and full note review. A newly required dictation is additional work, explicitly included in upkeep, not a free input.

Test native goal views and note templates first. s1 removes 3 of 20 units of repeated navigation, retaining 17 units of reading. s4 retains 8.4 of 14 units for actual note capture, correction and checking; only repeated organization is reduced. Estimates are unmeasured, not survey-derived time shares.

No session recording or autonomous clinical recommendation is proposed. Unsupported drafts are manually repaired within retained writing time, with additional setup/repair allowance below. Access, clinical confidentiality and applicable national consultation requirements must be established before use.

s5 is an ordinary same-system author save at the minimum share, fully retained and ungated; the author does not approve her own internal save. External disclosure or a changed treatment order requires its own actual action and authority, not this note save.
unknowns: Existing note inputs and goal views
Actual source and clinical-note access permissions
Whether note drafting saves time after complete review
research_questions: Observe the actual goal review and note writing without assuming a session transcript.
Test contradictory progress observations and unsupported risk statements, retaining manual note repair.

already_counted.description: Source reading, client discussion, clinical evaluation, note capture and complete checking remain in s1-s5.

incremental.description: Additional short dictation where required, template/source maintenance and failed-draft repair beyond retained case writing.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=17+35+30+8.4+1=91.4. Gross 8.6 minus 3 additional work gives net 5.6. Conservative case: unindexed goal revisions retain 18 of 20 lookup units and contradictory observations retain 13 of 14 writing units. Three gross units only cover the 3 upkeep; all clinical evaluation remains human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve the actual treatment discharge needs and current aftercare service information
Plan suitable follow-up goals and arrangements with the client to be discharged
Coordinate actual follow-up availability and responsibilities with the receiving care professionals
Write the actual aftercare plan and client instructions from the confirmed arrangements
outputs: final proposed aftercare plan and instructions

loop.purpose: Draft the existing aftercare plan wording from the counselor's actual arrangements, not choose care.
loop.input: Current working notes and confirmed follow-up arrangements.
loop.output: Draft plan and client instructions with dates and responsible contacts tied to sources.
loop.check: Counselor verifies every care instruction, responsibility, date, contact and qualification against confirmed arrangements and client understanding.
loop.stop: Unconfirmed availability, conflicting instructions or unsupported care advice stops for manual writing and coordination.
loop.why_not_simpler: Variable client-specific explanations require text organization; use only native fields when those suffice.

steps.what: Check the exact final aftercare instructions, client recipient and disclosure limits before release
inputs: final proposed aftercare plan and instructions

steps.what: Send the exact authorized aftercare instructions to the client through the existing secure channel
Save the aftercare plan in the existing treatment record
inputs: final proposed aftercare plan and instructions

tasks.design: Show maintained aftercare references in {OTHER}, then draft the actual plan from arrangements the counselor and client have made and the receiving professionals have confirmed. The counselor retains care planning and the exact final release check; the existing secure channel delivers only that authorized client version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Service references and plan wording can require repeated navigation and reconstruction after the care arrangements are agreed.
tasks.enabler_now: Native directory views, bounded plan drafting and the existing secure delivery function can remove those repeated operations.
tasks.still_hard: Suitable care, client agreement, actual service capacity and safe discharge arrangements require people.
tasks.human_edge: The counselor works with the client and receiving services to establish feasible and understood aftercare.

ambition.what: The same client-specific aftercare arrangements retain professional responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintained service references and a source-bound draft can support aftercare paperwork, while actual planning, availability confirmation and clinical release remain human.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the existing clinical record and secure client communication system. Boundary includes actual aftercare planning, real coordination, the existing plan and its actual delivery to the client; it does not invent a new referral packet or extra report.

The treating team already supplies treatment needs, discharge date and current plan. The actual directory owner supplies service name, eligibility description, contact and last verification date; maintaining a new directory is additional work if absent. s1 retains source reading, s2 client requirements and s3 actual availability/disclosure checks. No clean provider-capacity feed is assumed.

The counselor's existing working-note capture and substantive correction remain in s4, retaining 12 of 20 units; drafting removes repeated wording organization only. Additional required dictation, directory maintenance and failed-draft/delivery repair are counted below. No session recording or automatic care choice is assumed.

Native views/templates/delivery must be tried first. s1 removes 2 of 10 navigation units. s6 removes only actual manual recipient selection, instruction attachment and secure transmission where present today, not runtime or same-system persistence. If already native, that gain is zero.

s5 is the actual final professional client-instruction release check, not an approval added to the internal plan. It binds exact content, recipient and channel; changes invalidate a1. s7 is ordinary author save, ungated and fully retained at the minimum share. The saved plan is used by the ongoing care team.

Other professionals' real care and availability work is unchanged and outside this counselor's denominator, not a new work transfer. Any separate referral send requires its own actual step and release authority.
unknowns: Actual client delivery route and current manual actions
Whether a useful draft can be made from current working notes
research_questions: Trace one discharge from client planning to actual confirmed arrangements and client instructions.
Test unavailable follow-up, changed instructions and failed delivery; confirm content changes void release authorization.

already_counted.description: Reference checking, client planning, real service coordination, note capture/correction and final release checks remain in s1-s5 and ordinary persistence in s7.

incremental.description: Additional dictation where needed, service-reference upkeep and failed-draft or secure-delivery repair beyond retained case work.

approvals.approved_version: Exact s5-authorized client aftercare instruction content, recipient and secure channel; any change voids authorization.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=8+30+25+12+10+0+1=86. Gross 14 less 3 upkeep gives net 11. Conservative case: specialist service references retain 9 of 10 units and conflicting provider wording retains 18 of 20 writing units; only the real 4-unit delivery still automates. Seven gross less 4 added upkeep for those exceptions gives 3, with planning and coordination unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve the client's available emergency context and current crisis-service contacts when circumstances permit
Intervene directly as the client's advocate with the client and responding professionals to resolve the emergency situation
outputs: actual crisis intervention and response outcome

steps.what: Write the actual post-crisis clinical note describing advocacy, actions, observations and known outcome
inputs: actual crisis intervention and response outcome

loop.purpose: Organize the counselor's existing factual incident notes into the actual clinical note after the event.
loop.input: Counselor's current incident working notes and known response outcome.
loop.output: Draft factual post-crisis note with attributed observations and chronology.
loop.check: Counselor verifies every event, actor, time, action and risk statement; distinguish reported facts from direct observations and do not infer resolution.
loop.stop: Unclear chronology or unsupported risk wording stops for manual note writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Varied incident descriptions require free-text organization; use a fixed template alone if adequate.

steps.what: Save the checked crisis note in the client's existing clinical record

tasks.design: Keep a checked crisis-reference view available in the clinical record {OTHER}; it must never delay direct intervention. After the actual event, a bounded draft can organize existing counselor notes, with all factual and clinical checking retained before the ordinary record save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful contact references can be scattered, and the required post-event note has varied chronology.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference views and bounded note organization can address those small pieces without advising during a crisis.
tasks.still_hard: A crisis is dynamic and uncertain; advocacy, trust and coordination cannot be delegated to a drafting tool.
tasks.human_edge: The counselor responds to the person and actual emergency, understands the limits of known facts and advocates directly.

ambition.what: Direct crisis advocacy remains the task.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current reference views and source-bound post-event note drafting can support crisis documentation, without directing or replacing live intervention.

assumptions: Boundary includes the live advocacy and the actual post-crisis clinical record used for ongoing care. No new incident report, recorded conversation, risk score or automated emergency recommendation is invented.

{OTHER} is the clinical/case-record system. The current care team supplies existing emergency-context references; the actual contact-list owner supplies service, contact, coverage and last verification date. s1 includes current checking and fallback contact lookup. Unavailable information never blocks immediate human intervention.

s2 retains the actual live crisis work in full, including real-time calls to responding professionals. It is conversation, not an automated dispatch or an unmodeled written referral send. Any actual dispatch commitment or formal disclosure packet needs its own action and authority.

The counselor creates the actual incident facts during s2 and working-note capture in s3. s3 retains 11.2 of 14 units for factual capture, full meaning checks and manual correction; the removed 2.8 units concern organizing the note, not judging risk. Additional dictation and repair is budgeted, not supplied for free.

Test native contacts and note templates first. s1 removes only 1 of 5 navigation units. Ordinary same-system s4 persistence is near-zero, ungated, fully retained and brings no gain. Shares are unmeasured design estimates.
Only use the draft with appropriate clinical access and applicable national consultation arrangements. No session recording is assumed.
unknowns: Which post-crisis note is currently required and read
Whether drafting remains useful after complete checking
research_questions: Trace actual reference lookup and post-crisis note writing separately from live advocacy.
Test conflicting timelines and unknown outcomes without inventing a completed response or risk statement.

already_counted.description: Reference checking, all live advocacy, actual note capture and complete post-event checks remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Contact/template upkeep, additional dictation if necessary and failed-draft repair beyond the retained note checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=4+80+11.2+1=96.2. Gross 3.8 minus 2 added work gives net 1.8. Conservative case: emergency references require all 5 lookup units and a disputed timeline retains 12 of 14 note units. The 2 gross units only cover upkeep; live intervention is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve the actual counseling context, current care responsibilities and relevant professional contact references
inputs: existing professional contacts and care responsibilities

steps.what: Coordinate counseling responsibilities and care needs directly with the relevant mental health and other professionals
outputs: actual agreed coordination and unresolved questions

steps.what: Write the actual counseling coordination note with agreed responsibilities and unresolved questions
inputs: actual agreed coordination and unresolved questions

loop.purpose: Organize existing counselor notes into the actual coordination entry without assigning new care responsibilities.
loop.input: Current working notes, agreed responsibilities and unresolved questions.
loop.output: Draft coordination note distinguishing agreements, reports and pending questions.
loop.check: Counselor verifies each attribution, responsibility, deadline, care statement and unresolved issue against the actual discussion.
loop.stop: An unsupported agreement, unclear responsibility or conflicting care instruction stops for manual correction and clarification.
loop.why_not_simpler: Variable professional discussions require text organization; native structured fields suffice when no free-text organization is needed.

steps.what: Save the checked counseling coordination note in the existing clinical record

tasks.design: Show the existing care context and professional references in {OTHER}, then support writing the actual coordination entry from the counselor's current working notes. The professional conversation, care agreements, disclosure checks and complete note verification stay with the counselor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Care references can be dispersed, and coordination notes require organizing several professionals' contributions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native care views and bounded text organization can shorten those operations without making care agreements.
tasks.still_hard: Different professional perspectives, confidentiality and unclear responsibility require direct clarification.
tasks.human_edge: The counselor negotiates a shared understanding and knows when a conversation has not resolved the care issue.

ambition.what: The same professional coordination retains clinical responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native care views and source-bound drafting can support coordination notes, but actual professional agreement and clinical meaning checks remain human.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the actual clinical/case-record system. Boundary includes the actual coordination conversation and the existing clinical entry used by the care team. No automatic broadcast, referral letter or additional meeting report is invented.

The current care team supplies existing plan/context references, professional role, contact and current responsibility. s1 counts source reading and missing-contact checking; s2 includes current disclosure-authority checks and actual clarification with professionals. The proposed view does not assume a free cross-organization care feed.

The counselor's existing note capture remains in s3 along with full semantic checks and correction, retaining 16.8 of 24 units. Additional dictation where needed and failed-draft repair are counted below. No session recording is assumed.

Test native care views and structured note fields first. s1 removes 3 of 15 navigation units and retains 12 reading/checking units; s3 removes repeated text organization, not care reasoning. These unmeasured task-specific estimates must be tested against actual practice.

s4 is ordinary same-system author persistence, represented by a minimum share and fully retained without approval or saving. The note is an existing shared clinical record, not an external send. Any actual external packet or committed care order needs a separate version-bound action.
Other professionals' actual discussions and care work remain theirs and are not included in the counselor's denominator or shifted to them as new unpaid capture.
unknowns: Actual coordination-note use and current structured fields
Whether working notes support useful drafting after full review
research_questions: Observe reference retrieval, the professional conversation and actual coordination-note writing separately.
Test a disputed responsibility and an unresolved care instruction without fabricating agreement.

already_counted.description: Context reading, actual professional discussion, working-note capture, full clinical meaning checks and ordinary persistence remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Additional dictation where required, source/template maintenance and failed-draft repairs beyond retained clinical checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=12+60+16.8+1=89.8. Gross 10.2 minus 3 added work gives net 7.2. Conservative case: fragmented care references retain 14 of 15 lookup units and disputed responsibilities retain 22 of 24 writing units. Three gross units just cover the 3 added work; the professional discussion is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The counselor retains client work, care judgement and professional coordination, while dated reference views and carefully checked note drafts may reduce repeated paperwork.
skills_to_grow: Check clinical draft meaning against original notes
Keep observation, reported fact and professional conclusion distinct
Manage care-record access and exact disclosure versions
role.ambitious_version: Keep a clear clinical record that reflects the actual client work and professional agreements without adding unsupported risk or care statements.

job.title: Substance Abuse and Behavioral Disorder Counselors
